python3 -c "

python3 -c '
import pathlib, re, sys
ROOT = pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/replay-aruxgwzg/adapters")
Q3 = "\"\"\""
TODO_RE = re.compile(r"^# TODO\(migration\): (.*)$")
TIMEOUT_RE = re.compile(r"add a module constant TIMEOUT_MS = (\d+) and return it under the key \"timeout_ms\"")
BUMP = "bump VERSION from 1 to 2"
RENAME = "rename handle to dispatch; the body stays as it is"
RETIRE = "this adapter is retired: add DEPRECATED = True and make handle raise NotImplementedError"

def template(name, todo):
    return (Q3 + "Transport adapter " + name + "." + Q3 + "\n"
        + "# TODO(migration): " + todo + "\n\nVERSION = 1\n\n\ndef handle(payload):\n"
        + "    return {\"adapter\": \"" + name + "\", \"version\": VERSION, \"payload\": payload}\n")

def migrate(name, text):
    lines = text.split("\n")
    m = TODO_RE.match(lines[1]) if len(lines) > 1 else None
    if not m:
        sys.exit(name + ": no TODO(migration) on line 2")
    todo = m.group(1)
    if text != template(name, todo):
        sys.exit(name + ": does not match the expected template")
    body = text.replace(lines[1] + "\n", "", 1)
    tm = TIMEOUT_RE.fullmatch(todo)
    if todo == BUMP:
        kind = "bump"
        body = body.replace("VERSION = 1\n", "VERSION = 2\n", 1)
    elif tm:
        kind = "timeout"
        body = body.replace("VERSION = 1\n", "VERSION = 1\nTIMEOUT_MS = " + tm.group(1) + "\n", 1)
        body = body.replace("\"payload\": payload}", "\"payload\": payload, \"timeout_ms\": TIMEOUT_MS}", 1)
    elif todo == RENAME:
        kind = "rename"
        body = body.replace("def handle(payload):", "def dispatch(payload):", 1)
    elif todo == RETIRE:
        kind = "retire"
        body = body.replace("VERSION = 1\n", "VERSION = 1\nDEPRECATED = True\n", 1)
        body = re.sub(r"    return \{.*\}\n", "    raise NotImplementedError\n", body, count=1)
    else:
        sys.exit(name + ": unrecognised TODO: " + todo)
    return kind, body

paths = sorted(ROOT.glob("a*.py"))
assert len(paths) == 96, len(paths)
# validate all before writing any
planned = [(p, *migrate(p.stem, p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))) for p in paths]
counts = {}
for p, kind, body in planned:
    p.write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
    counts[kind] = counts.get(kind, 0) + 1
print(counts, "total", sum(counts.values()))
'
